'''Sweet ice''' was a dessert served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]] in [[3653 BBY]]. [[Kajin Savaros]] consumed sweet ice on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
